regime.label: Dealer short-gamma coil compressed inside the 1080/1100 box, 26 points below the 1110 gamma flip
evidence: Cumulative net GEX turns positive only at strike 1110, about 26 points above today's 1083.8 spot, keeping dealers short-gamma at the money for a 2nd straight tracked session (flip held near 1110 on Jul 24 too).

Spot sits inside a tight 1080/1100 box: 1080 is both the largest overall call-OI strike (2,088) and the near-put-wall (1,312 OI, +4.6% day/day on 596 vol - Vol2Vol-live), while 1100 holds the near-call-wall (1,731 OI, +4.0% on 570 vol - also live).
ATM IV rose to 14.78% (+0.29pt day/day, +7.7% over 5 sessions from 13.72% on Jul 21) even as spot fell 8.4 points - hedging demand building into the drop, not complacency.
The deep 910 put wall (9,687 OI) grew only 0.6% on 65 contracts of volume - Vol2Vol-stale, a structural tail hedge rather than an active support level.

S50U26.today_summary: S50U26 future is 1083.8, down 8.4 points (-0.77%) on the day and 8.9 points below Friday's 1092.7 close. Put OI (26,671) outweighs call OI (14,536) 1.83:1, but call OI grew faster overnight (+723 contracts, +5.2%) than put OI (+425, +1.6%), concentrated at the 1080 and 1100 strikes. Cumulative net GEX only turns positive at strike 1110, about 26 points above spot, leaving dealers short-gamma inside the 1080-1100 box where price has chopped all week. ATM IV rose to 14.78% (+0.29pt day/day) despite the pullback, a mild expansion alongside the added OI.
what_changed: Spot fell 8.4 points (-0.77%) to 1083.8, extending a 5-session slide of 12.8 points (-1.17%) from 1096.6 on Jul 21.
Call OI jumped 723 contracts (+5.2%) to 14,536 overnight, the fastest single-day build of the past 5 sessions, concentrated at 1080 (2,088 OI) and 1100 (1,731 OI).
25Δ skew deepened further call-rich, from -0.37 on Jul 24 to -0.77 today, even as the near-money 1080/1100 walls both added OI on rising volume.
Max pain reverted to 1060 after a one-session drift to 1070 on Jul 24, holding a tight 10-point range across the tracked window.
S50U26.five_day_thesis: Over the last 5 sessions the S50U26 future slid 12.8 points (-1.17%) from 1096.6 (Jul 21) to 1083.8 (Jul 28) while both call OI (+17.8%, 12,339 to 14,536) and put OI (+9.7%, 24,303 to 26,671) built steadily. Max pain has barely moved, touching 1070 once (Jul 24) before reverting to 1060, a tight 10-point range across the whole window. ATM IV expanded 1.06pt (+7.7%) from 13.72% to 14.78% even as price fell, showing hedgers paying up for protection rather than the calm of a genuine long-gamma pin. The 1080 strike is now the pivot - the largest overall call-OI strike (2,088) and, as spot compressed down toward it, also the largest sub-spot put-OI strike within 5% (1,312, up from 1,254 on Jul 24) - with spot sitting just 3.8 points above it and the 1080/1100 box otherwise unchanged from 2 sessions ago. With cumulative GEX not turning positive until 1110, a break of the 1080/1100 band this week would leave dealers short-gamma and forced to chase, not fade, the move.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1080P / 1050P
strategies.rationale: A break of the 1080 lower rail (near-put-wall, Vol2Vol-confirmed live at 596 vol) leaves dealers short-gamma below the 1110 flip and forced to sell into further weakness, accelerating a move toward the 1060 max pain.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit ≈11.2 pts (buy 1080P ask 25.0, sell 1050P bid 13.8) on a 30-point wide spread; max gain ≈18.8 pts.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 1100 (the box's upper rail / near-call-wall) reasserts range-bound chop and negates the breakdown thesis.

strategies.name: Call debit spread 1100C / 1130C
strategies.rationale: A break above the 1100 upper rail (near-call-wall, Vol2Vol-confirmed live at 570 vol) still sits below the 1110 gamma flip, so dealers stay short-gamma into the move and are forced to buy strength rather than cap it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit ≈14.4 pts (buy 1100C ask 23.2, sell 1130C bid 8.8) on a 30-point wide spread; max gain ≈15.6 pts.
strategies.invalidation: A close back below 1080 (the box's lower rail / near-put-wall) reasserts the range and negates the breakout thesis.

S50U26.prediction: Base case is continued chop inside the 1080/1100 box, with the 1080 strike - 3.8 points below spot - as the key line given it is simultaneously the largest call-OI wall and the live near-put-wall. A confirmed close below 1080 opens a short-gamma slide toward the 1060 max-pain anchor (23.8 points below spot); a close back above 1100 instead re-opens the 1120-1150 call-OI shelf, still short-gamma until 1110. Given cash settlement, treat either magnet as a tendency, not a floor or ceiling.
S50U26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not a recommendation to execute any trade. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning toward max pain (1060) are structurally weaker than for share-settled single-stock options; treat every wall, the 1060 max pain, and the 1080/1100 box as a tendency, not a guarantee, with 63 days still left to the Sep 29 expiry.
